plugins.name: product
plugins.description: The product role on contract v3: decides what to build — value and business-viability risk. Pre-registered hypothesis discipline (named metric, numeric threshold, decision rule fixed before data; guardrails non-empty), one-pager problem-without-solution lens, assumption-mapped research, and a verdict that is the mechanical application of the registered rule. Ships skills: hypothesis-testing, assumption-mapping, one-pager, opportunity-solution-tree, guardrail-metrics.
